purpose: Test broader source-verified supervision and a motif-fraction-independent objective for isolated-fragment generation.
data: Require all four independently audited source-backed data shards and exact preservation of the original512 training and16 development inputs. Both corpora add20-residue left/center/right conditions alongside the original nine fractional conditions. Broad data retains only prospectively qualified endpoints, with every rejection retained in the ledger. No refold outcome is a training label.
objective: Control uses established residue weight3 on condition-present motifs. Balanced uses half of each condition-present example loss on motif residues and half on scaffold residues, independent of motif size. Null examples remain uniformly residue-weighted; absent or all-residue motifs use the uniform fallback. No decoder gradient or extra noise/time/drop/self-conditioning draws. All other training settings remain inherited.
training: Four fresh-optimizer continuations of the same6000-update EMA state. First40-update oneRTX profiles perarm; require finite gradients, all historical and pose controls, <=75GiB. Then2000updates with unchanged bucket batches64/32/16/8, LR, EMA, and original32training/16development evaluation panel. At a fixed corpus, both objectives must have identical target/condition/noise/time/drop and learning-rate traces. Across corpus sizes, match bucket/noise/time/drop/LR schedules; protein IDs necessarily differ. Evaluate8000-update endpoints, without choosing the500-update checkpoint posthoc.
evaluation: Evaluate all qualified endpoints on the frozen64additional development families under bothcenter30percent andcenter20residue constraints,4fixed noises/family,50flow steps,AE3,CFG1. Use8fixed-motifCA-onlyProteinMPNN designs per strict raw match and the unchangedFP32refold recipe. Denominator256 outputs perarm/task includes every generation failure. Reuse each task's existing64native controls at exactly its original8attempts, with no attempt pooling. decision: No further duration sweep or best-checkpoint selection. Candidate progress requires improved strict same-refold scaffold success across families, with uncertainty reported at family level. Raw motif retention alone cannot establish progress; preserve designability tradeoffs and all failed arms. This is a developmental factorial test, not a blind benchmark or a pure corpus scaling law.
